defaults.encoding: JSON bodies add Content-Type application/json; empty actions omit it; multipart runner creates boundary
defaults.given_semantics: Deep-merge given into state keyed by decimal IDs; null record deletes; arrays replace. Reset independently for every case unless a sequence says otherwise. Group posts are stored with group_id and audience 'group' in fixture state (the database keeps an inert audience; see the data plan). Notification records use type/group_id/entry_id/state for group notices. next_ids are the AUTOINCREMENT allocation counters; deleted high IDs are never reused.
defaults.response_semantics: Exact body/headers subset; messages illustrative except the pinned stale/conflict codes. bytes_fixture paths relative to repository; empty_body true means zero bytes. Header null override removes default. Signal recipients are sorted user IDs or all_authenticated.
defaults.expect_state_semantics: Deep subset after the request; null record means absent. unchanged asserts no persisted mutation; read denials also preserve state.
defaults.synthetic_warning: Test-only future interface fixtures; no production seeds/imports; not actual current API behavior.

recovery_examples.name: missed-signal-reconnect-refetch
steps: member session socket drops while the creator removes the member and commits
socket reconnects with the same valid session
client discards protected group lists, members, posts, comments and notices and refetches the displayed screens
former member receives 404 for group content and role none on discovery metadata; no server replay is needed

recovery_examples.name: committed-write-failed-signal
steps: invitation, notice and unique identity commit
post-commit hook fails or the recipient is offline
HTTP response stays 201; no rollback or duplicate notice is created
recipient's next connect/focus/60-second fetch lists the pending invitation with actions

recovery_examples.name: restart-preserves-membership-and-stale-identities
steps: accept an invitation, remove another member and cancel a departed inviter's invitation
restart the backend with the same versioned SQLite file and private media root
memberships, resolved notice states and retained contributions persist
old invitation, request and membership identities remain stale; no ID is reused

recovery_examples.name: pre-phase-4-upgrade
steps: start migrations 000006/000007 on a Phase 3 database with personal posts, drafts, discussions, notices and media
every earlier ID, row, count, notice and file association is unchanged; all posts have group_id NULL
group tables are empty and notifications accept the two new types
repeated and failed starts leave one consistent schema version or a refused dirty state
